name: Rubescent-Corbel
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
Every altitude has its own weather opinion, and the hull is the only referee. Mooring in the quiet shear zones is a skill measured in survived seasons.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
